note: Curated identity decisions for the Top 500 SA directory batch. Everything not listed here resolves from the source name itself. `mergeInto` folds a second listing into an existing listing's record because the source itself shows one legal entity; `aliases` record the name forms the same entity appears under (including the shorter names the contact directory uses), so employer resolution lands on the curated record instead of leaving a dataset-only stub beside it; `enrich` attaches the listing to a company that is already curated, without touching its sourced placements.
